d: Smart Technology Solutions is a Saudi-based technology solutions provider delivering IT infrastructure, systems integration, and business technology services to public and private sector clients. Working across the Information Technology and Services sector, the company supports organizations with reliable, practical technology environments that connect infrastructure, communications, and business operations.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the delivery of network and infrastructure projects that support essential client environments. You will work across implementation and integration activities, partnering with project stakeholders to help ensure systems are configured effectively, installed to plan, and handed over with the right technical documentation in place.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Communication Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
0–2 years of experience in Network / IT Infrastructure Projects.
Strong knowledge of VLANs, Switching and basic Routing, with familiarity with TCP/IP and Subnetting preferred.
Hands-on experience with managed Layer 2 / Layer 3 switches.
Good understanding of Wi-Fi networks, PoE, Fiber Optics, SFPs, and structured cabling.
Basic knowledge of Firewalls, NAT, and VPN technologies.
Ability to read network diagrams, technical drawings, and project documentation.
Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with clients, vendors, consultants, and internal teams.
Eligible to work in Saudi Arabia.
Experience with networking platforms such as Cisco, Aruba, Fortinet, Huawei, HPE, or equivalent is preferred.
CCNA or equivalent networking knowledge is highly preferred.
Vendor certifications such as Cisco, Aruba, Fortinet, or Huawei are considered a plus.
Previous experience with ELV / ICT system integration is an advantage.
r: Implement and configure network infrastructure, including switches, wireless access points, VOIP, CCTV, access control and related systems.
Perform network configuration including VLANs, IP addressing, routing, switching, and basic firewall configurations.
Participate in site surveys and review project requirements, drawings, and BOQs.
Supervise and coordinate installation activities with vendors, contractors, and other project teams.
Troubleshoot network and infrastructure issues during project implementation.
Support the implementation and integration of systems such as CCTV, Access Control, IP Telephony, Wi-Fi, Meeting Room & AV Solutions, Digital Signage, and other ELV / ICT systems.
Perform testing, commissioning, snagging, and project handover activities.
Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including network diagrams, IP/VLAN plans, configurations, and As-Built documentation.

d: The Arbor School seeks a special individual for an exciting opportunity within our Secondary School. The successful candidate will play a key role in fulfilling the school's ecological and sustainability vision, while inspiring and challenging students to achieve their full academic potential.

The Arbor School is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Secondary Teacher of Maths who is passionate about teaching and learning and committed to delivering outstanding educational experiences across Key Stages 3, 4 and 5.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and dedicated teacher with strong subject knowledge, high expectations and a proven ability to support students of all abilities. The successful applicant will demonstrate a track record of excellent teaching and learning, securing strong student outcomes and creating a positive, engaging and supportive classroom environment.
Experience or the ability to teach Further Maths would be considered an advantage.

The Arbor School opened in 2018 with a very different vision of what education could and should be – experiential, authentic and inspired by the natural beauty, human ingenuity, and profound ecological and social challenges of the Arabian Peninsula.

The cultivation of a learning community uniquely committed to understanding and restoring the health of ecological and human communities as interconnected parts of a whole requires equal parts optimism, ambition, and humility. A fundamental belief in the inherent goodness of people and their capacity to act with empathy and compassion underscores the sense of hope that is fundamental to learning for a sustainable future.

The resilience and determination to tackle challenges that have grown to global proportions are essential to finding sustainable solutions and orchestrating the social changes needed to grow them to scale. The realisation that comes from recognising that we are all students – never a master – drives our commitment to ignite a lifelong love of learning.

Recognising the interconnected nature of the cognitive, affective, and participative domains, and their roles in shaping learning, we are pursuing a holistic approach to teaching and learning, designed to prepare learners:
To understand the interconnected concepts of sustainability, individual and collective well-being, and environmental and social justice.
To find purpose, meaning and joy in their interactions with the natural world and with each other, and to seek to understand people who are different from themselves.
To experience a sense of accomplishment and self-efficacy through their actions at home, in school and in the wider world.

Arbor teachers are part of a community which is inclusive, fun-loving, and active. Arbor teachers enjoy authentic friendships with their colleagues, positive relationships with school leaders who care for their wellbeing, and are a team in the true sense.

Arbor teachers are resilient in the face of challenge, stable and calm in the face of change, and creative and flexible when solving problems. Arbor teachers bring their passions and interests to enrich our school and are clear that there is an expectation to do so.
We commit to meeting agreed deadlines, communicating proactively with an assumption of positive intent, and sharing a passion for providing an education of the highest quality to our students.
The successful candidate will be a passionate and experienced Maths teacher, confident in delivering the British curriculum across KS3, KS4 and KS5.

Working closely with the Head of Mathematics, the successful candidate will contribute to curriculum development, deliver engaging and challenging lessons, and support students in achieving their full academic potential.

We are seeking a reflective, collaborative and enthusiastic practitioner who demonstrates high academic expectations, a genuine commitment to student wellbeing and an appreciation of the unique ecological ethos of The Arbor School.
Safeguard and promote the welfare of all students in accordance with Arbor's Safeguarding Framework, policies and Code of Conduct.
Positively and actively promote the Arbor vision, mission and values.
Ensure professional practice is aligned with the Arbor Staff Handbook and relevant school policies and procedures.
Support the development and review of the Mathematics curriculum and schemes of work across KS3, KS4 and KS5.
Plan, deliver and evaluate engaging and challenging lessons in accordance with National Curriculum requirements, with a focus on pace, higher-order questioning and critical thinking.
Use effective assessment strategies and student progress data to inform teaching, provide appropriate challenge and support strong academic outcomes.
Establish a safe, inclusive and stimulating learning environment that encourages curiosity, confidence and a love of Mathematics.
Work collaboratively with the Head of Mathematics, colleagues, pastoral and inclusion teams to support the academic and personal development of every student.
Develop enrichment opportunities that inspire students to explore Mathematics beyond the classroom.
Incorporate real-world applications, sustainability and cross-curricular learning opportunities where appropriate.
Actively engage in professional development and contribute positively to Arbor's professional learning community.
Bachelor's degree or higher in Maths or a directly related subject, with a PGCE and QTS or an equivalent recognised teaching qualification.
A minimum of two years' relevant teaching experience, ideally within a reputable British curriculum school.
Strong subject knowledge and experience teaching Mathematics across the Secondary School.
A proven track record of high-quality teaching and learning, with the ability to support excellent student progress and attainment.
Experience or the ability to teach Further Mathematics would be considered advantageous.
Fluent or native-level English language skills.
Excellent communication, organisational and interpersonal skills.
A caring, reflective and collaborative approach to teaching, with a genuine commitment to student wellbeing and the Arbor ethos.
A competitive tax-free compensation package will be provided in accordance with the School's policy and UAE labour law regulations.
To apply for this position, please complete the application on TES and upload:
An up-to-date CV with a recent photograph included.
A letter of application, no longer than two pages in length, outlining your educational philosophy and suitability for The Arbor School.
The Arbor School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all students in our care and expects all applicants to share this commitment.

We hold ourselves to a high standard of effective safer recruitment practices, with specific attention to child protection. All appointments are subject to CV and qualification checks, interview, identity checks, criminal record checks and satisfactory references.
All appointments are subject to the approval of the Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA) and the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE).

We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Manager – Dams & Tailings Storage Facilities (TSF) to lead the execution of major dam, tailings, hydraulic and water-infrastructure projects.The successful candidate will take responsibility for the day-to-day management of construction activities, ensuring that works are delivered safely, efficiently and in accordance with the contract, programme, technical specifications and quality requirements.
q: Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering or a comparable discipline.
Minimum 10 years of relevant construction experience, with substantial experience in dams, Tailings Storage Facilities, hydropower, mining infrastructure or major heavy-civil projects.
Proven experience in a senior site or construction management position.

Strong practical knowledge of dam and/or TSF construction, particularly bulk earthworks, engineered fill and embankments, filter/drainage systems, geosynthetics, concrete works and foundation treatment.
Experience managing multidisciplinary and multinational construction teams.
Good understanding of construction planning, quality management, HSE and contractual requirements.
Strong leadership, communication and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to work internationally and on project-based assignments.
Experience with large-scale earthworks and stringent material placement, compaction and QA/QC requirements is highly desirable.
Fluent English is essential; professional Spanish is highly desirable.
We offer a comprehensive package & competitive compensation based on experience & knowledge.
You will have the option to collaborate with other international units in the region and oversees.
We have experienced colleagues who will help with the onboarding.
You will join a highly motivated team with an open-door policy & striving to develop the future.
r: Lead and coordinate construction activities for major dams, Tailings Storage Facilities (TSF) and hydraulic infrastructure projects.
Manage site teams, subcontractors, suppliers, plant and construction resources.

Plan and coordinate earthworks, embankments, staged TSF raises, liner systems, drainage systems, filter and transition zones, concrete structures, foundations, grouting and associated hydraulic works.
Manage interfaces between earthworks, geotechnical works, HDPE/geosynthetic installations, drainage and water-management systems.
Monitor construction progress against the approved programme and implement corrective measures where required.
Coordinate closely with the Project Manager, Engineering, Commercial, Planning, QA/QC and HSE teams.
Review construction methods, temporary works requirements, work sequences and resource planning.
Ensure strict compliance with approved designs, technical specifications, QA/QC requirements and project-specific dam and TSF safety requirements.
Interface with the Employer, Engineer/Consultant, designers, subcontractors and other project stakeholders.
Identify construction risks, technical constraints and potential delays at an early stage and support the development of practical mitigation measures.
Support contractual and commercial matters through accurate site records, progress information and timely identification of changes or additional works.
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure that HSE requirements are embedded in all construction activities.

d: The Senior Engineer is responsible for managing and delivering the assigned works section, discipline or project package from planning through completion. The role provides overall technical, construction and operational leadership to ensure that works are executed safely, in accordance with contract requirements, approved drawings and specifications, within the approved programme and budget, and to the required quality standards. The position leads site engineering and construction teams, coordinates subcontractors and stakeholders, manages section-level resources and performance, and reports progress, risks and key issues to project management.

Lead the planning, coordination and execution of all activities within the assigned works section, ensuring alignment with the project objectives, contract requirements, approved programme and budget Interpret and monitor project drawings and specifications to ensure construction activities align with contract requirements and Ministry/industry standards
Lead the planning, coordination and execution of all activities within the assigned works section, ensuring alignment with the project objectives, contract requirements, approved programme and budget

Review contract documents, drawings, specifications, bills of quantities and relevant authority requirements; identify scope gaps, discrepancies, interfaces and potential risks and ensure timely resolution
Develop and maintain section-level construction plans, look-ahead programmes, work sequences, resource plans and recovery measures in coordination with the Planning Engineer and project management
Direct and coordinate Site Engineers, General Foremen, Foremen, Surveyors, subcontractors and other site personnel to achieve planned production, quality and safety targets

Provide technical guidance and review construction methodologies, method statements, risk assessments, inspection and test plans (ITPs), temporary works proposals and technical submissions before onward approval, as applicable

Oversee execution of roadworks and infrastructure activities, including earthworks, formation, sub-base, road base, kerbs, paving, asphalt works, drainage, stormwater networks, utility corridors, ducting, diversions and reinstatement, as applicable to the project

Coordinate construction interfaces with utility authorities, clients, consultants, other contractors and relevant stakeholders; ensure required clearances, permits, inspections and approvals are obtained before affected works commence

Monitor quality performance and ensure compliance with project specifications, approved materials, ITPs and testing requirements; review inspection records, test results, non-conformance reports and corrective actions

Lead the implementation of project HSE requirements within the section, including site risk controls, excavation safety, temporary works, lifting activities, traffic management, confined-space activities and heat-stress controls, as applicable
Monitor actual progress, productivity, labour, plant, materials and subcontractor performance against the programme and resource budgets; identify variances and implement corrective actions
Coordinate procurement and delivery requirements with the procurement and logistics teams, ensuring timely availability of approved materials, plant, equipment and specialist subcontractor resources

Review quantities, measurements, site records and progress information; support preparation and verification of interim payment applications, variation records, daywork sheets and other contractual submissions

Identify potential variations, delays, disruption events and claims-related matters; maintain contemporaneous records and promptly notify the Project Manager / Commercial Manager in accordance with contract procedures
Manage technical queries, requests for information, design clarifications and site instructions, ensuring responses are obtained and incorporated into the construction plan
Chair or participate in section coordination and progress meetings; communicate priorities, constraints, decisions and action owners to the site team and project stakeholders
Ensure accurate daily and weekly reporting, progress measurement, resource records, quality documentation, HSE records and updated as-built information for the assigned section
Coordinate testing, commissioning, inspections, snagging, completion documentation and handover of the assigned works section
Promote continuous improvement, efficient construction methods, cost awareness, reduction of material wastage and effective utilisation of labour, plant and equipment
Escalate significant technical, programme, commercial, quality or safety risks to project management in a timely manner and recommend practical mitigation measures
Perform other duties commensurate with the position as assigned by management
q: Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline. A Diploma in Civil Engineering may be considered where supported by substantial relevant construction and supervisory experience
Typically 8-12 years of relevant experience in civil infrastructure construction with a main contractor, including substantial experience managing roadworks and utilities packages or sections
Demonstrated experience leading multi-disciplinary site teams and coordinating subcontractors on road, drainage, stormwater and utility infrastructure projects
Strong working knowledge of construction methods, contract drawings, specifications, quality requirements, construction planning, resource management and site HSE controls
Working knowledge of applicable Bahrain requirements, authority coordination processes and project specifications; Bahrain or wider GCC project experience is strongly preferred
Ability to interpret programmes, monitor productivity, manage section-level costs and understand the commercial implications of site decisions
Strong leadership, communication, coordination, problem-solving, decision-making and reporting skills

Competent in relevant engineering and project management applications, including Microsoft Office and project planning / reporting tools; knowledge of AutoCAD and/or similar drawing review tools is an advantage.
